title: Fusionad
tagline: We tried our best but alas we have only used the sdk extensively
description:
Hey guys, I appreciate the help a lot through this adventure! We really tried to extend Fusion+ off EVM but unfortunately our time has come to an end and we have failed. We faced many custom errors that we could not overcome. It has been a pleasure.

Our main challenges were mocking all the orders and immutable arguments but we ended up using the sdk to do this primarily in the cross-chain-resolver-example testing script. From here we deployed resolver and factory contracts (using the LOP one on the EVM chain). Unfortunately, we only got the escrow src contract up using Resolver.deploySrc but was never able to complete the swap :(
how_its_made:
We deployed Resolver and Factory contracts, and got one Escrow source contract up on arbitrum. The sdk was used to create orders and hasklocks and then we used these to create the escrow source contract through Resolver.deploySrc. Unfortunately, with the escrow source contract up, we had some trouble withdrawing the funds.

We also used ICreateX instead of Create3 to deploy contracts on the Monad chain
